title: SEC EDGAR Filings, XBRL & Form D Search Input

identifiers.title: Company Tickers or 10-Digit CIKs
identifiers.description: Optional list of US stock tickers (e.g. 'AAPL', 'MSFT') or SEC CIK numbers to fetch company submissions and annual/quarterly US-GAAP XBRL metrics. Leave empty to run EFTS Form D / full-text search only.

forms.title: Company Filing Form Types
forms.description: SEC form types to keep per company in Company Mode (e.g. 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, 4, S-1, DEF 14A).

limitPerCompany.title: Recent Filings per Company
limitPerCompany.description: Maximum number of recent matching filings to include per company identifier.

includeXbrl.title: Include Annual & Quarterly US-GAAP XBRL Financials
includeXbrl.description: Fetch companyfacts JSON and extract clean annual (10-K/FY) and quarterly (10-Q) metrics preferring modern ASC 606 revenue tags sorted by period end date.

searchQuery.title: EFTS Full-Text Search Query (Optional)
searchQuery.description: Optional full-text keyword or phrase query sent to efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index (e.g. '"artificial intelligence"' or 'merger agreement').

formTypes.title: EFTS Search Form Types (e.g. Form D, 8-K)
formTypes.description: Optional SEC form filters for EFTS search mode (e.g. ['D', 'D/A'] for private startup funding filings, or ['8-K'] for M&A and material events).

dateFrom.title: EFTS Search Start Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: Optional filing start date in YYYY-MM-DD format for EFTS search mode.

dateTo.title: EFTS Search End Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: Optional filing end date in YYYY-MM-DD format for EFTS search mode.

maxSearchResults.title: Max EFTS Search Results
maxSearchResults.description: Maximum number of EFTS search / Form D filing records to return.

contactEmail.title: SEC Fair Access Contact Email (Optional)
contactEmail.description: Optional contact email placed into the SEC EDGAR User-Agent header per SEC Fair Access Policy. Defaults to the Actor's built-in Fair Access contact.
